notes.title: July Bug Fix / Improvements Update
notes.content: [p]We've got a small bug fix and improve update for folks, which aligns the Steam version with all of the updates from the recently launched mobile version.[/p][p][/p][p]With these fixes out of the way, we'll be turning out attention to some new content! We're in the prototype phase for a new brawler and will share some more detail soon. [/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the love & support for Rustbowl Rumble![/p][p][/p][p][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/p][p]- Health previews in battle now show current health as well[/p][p]- Slight increase to size of buff icon values[/p][p][/p][p][b]FIXES[/b][/p][p]- #1910: Cards like Weak Spot and similar will no longer be chosen for random card upgrades that aren't useful[/p][p]- #1913: Fixed an issue where the town camera could have an incorrect zoom level if inspecting a unit while the battle is finishing[/p][p]- #1914: Fixed a bug where Glowing perk didn't give bonus stamina as intended[/p][p]- #1915: When resuming a game, cards in the shop are no longer missing their upgrades[/p][p]- #1923: Block is now always consumed before armor[/p][p]- #1924: Cards that grant energy now properly show a blue instead of a green lightning bolt icon[/p][p]- #1926: Fixed an issue where entering a battle, exiting, and revisiting town would populate shops with different items[/p][p]- #1927: Fixed a rare issue where buying perks could cause money to go negative[/p][p]- #1928: Dealing damage with Mischief after completing her Bad Apple perk should apply the correct amount of poison[/p][p]- Fix a few memory leaks to improve performance in longer sessions[/p]

notes.title: Bug Fix Update - May 2
notes.content:
IMPROVEMENTS
- Tapa's starting deck has been updated with Tapa specific cards / mods

BUGS

notes.title: First Patch: Bug Fixes, Improvements, and Balance
notes.content:
First patch is a small one to address a few bugs that were reported by the community (especially those with the most negative impact), as well as a few minor balance updates. 

Lastly, on Iron+ difficulty, you'll get to choose which vendors you want to visit rather than having to restart if you don't like your choices in town.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- When starting a run in Iron+ (or higher), you'll now get to choose a schedule to start your run

[b]BUGS[/b]
- Cutscenes now respect master volume setting
- Fixed a crash related to the Swampalina boss fight
- The 'Peaceful' feat should now trigger properly, even if a minion attacks
- The Sharpen effect from 'Salvage' now triggers feats such as 'May the Forge Be With You'
- Fixed a softlock related to the Two Face feat and the perk Flash mob
- Fixed a softlock related to the Guerilla perk and Large and In Charge wild card

[b]BALANCE[/b]
- Reduced difficulty of Waggu and Sludgehammer boss fights on Iron+ league
- Round timer adds 4 rounds when you complete a wave (up from 3)

[h2]Future Updates[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/912a587ee52f5634a71eebea508bb54cde2b5233.png[/img]

We've got more content planned for Bramble in the coming months, including new heroes and new cards. Other possibilities include new difficulty levels, etc. Let us know in the comments what type of content you'd most like to see!

notes.title: Welcome to the Bramble Royale!
notes.content:
It's been a long road but we're finally here: the 1.0 release of Meteorfall: Bramble Royale! 

We're proud to share that everything you see in Bramble Royale was 100% created by humans: all the art, sound, code, etc. was created by actual people and not AI.

[h2]Welcome to the Arena![/h2]
We're excited to welcome you all to the Bramble Royale tournament - an inaugural tournament of heroes from all across Meteorfall, competing to win the legendary Mask of the Uberlich. The tournament is hosted by the titular Bramble and his good pal Grimble.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/6fe5e33784d712d81e71dc84756ddcc81c352dbb.png[/img]

[h2]Do you have what it takes to win the Bramble Royale?[/h2]
Bramble Royale is a fast-paced deck builder set in the world of Meteorfall. You start by choosing a team and then over the course of a run, you'll battle other teams, customize / upgrade your deck, and then battle another team until you make you way to the end of the tournament. Win or lose, you'll start over at the end with a new team. 

Each run is a bit different, in typical roguelike fashion. There are different enemy teams you'll face, the cards you're offered are different, etc... The goal is that the game should be replayable for months to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/89ca873a1731f653247e9ad45d36b917414b4e32.png[/img]

There are A LOT of deck builders out there and we didn't want to just clone what's already there. From Day 1, Bramble Royale was built to feel fast-paced and fresh.

[list]
[*] Team-based. Your card & perk pool is determined by your team. New combinations of heroes can unlock strategies.
[*] Any hero can use any card: even if 'belongs' to another hero. This helps make the game faster paced and unlocks a lot of interesting strategies.
[*]Modular upgrades. You can mix and match upgrades on cards. Lots of really wild combos you can pull off with clever use of upgrades.
[*] Play a card, draw card. There are two types of cards in Bramble Royale: Items and Abilities. With abilities, you automatically draw a card when you play them, giving you a ton of inherent card draw. This helps quickly cycle through your deck and helps the game feel more dynamic.
[*]Grid based tactics. Positoning matters - put units behind your tanks or move units around the battlefield to influence where enemy hits land.
[/list]
We think the result is something unlike any other deckbuilder you've played and hopefully brings some new ideas to the genre.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/fad783e503face26b966a80d2d20835cd3f30acf.png[/img]
[h2]OK, so what is Meteorfall exactly?[/h2]
Bramble Royale is the third game in a series of games called Meteorfall. The first was simply called Meteorfall and released on iOS/Android in 2017. Krumit's Tale (Steam/iOS/Android) followed in 2020. 

Although the games all take place in the world of Meteorfall, all the games are quite different! We pride ourselves on creating new, unique mechanics for each game with similar themes unifying the games. For instance, all the games involve deck building mechanics, a roguelike 'run-based' gameplay, etc... Additionally, there is significant overlap between the characters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/67ecfd29b7ab8623c925525c6bb412a5e58994f5.png[/img]
[i]Meteorfall: Krumit's Tale[/i]

[h2]What's Next for Bramble Royale?[/h2]
This isn't the road for Bramble Royale. We plan to support the game with a number of free content updates. That includes new cards and most importantly, new heroes! We're in the process of prototyping some new mechanics for these new heroes and our goal is to really push the envelope with the hero design so that they feel totally different than any of the other heroes.

Naturally, we'll be checking the Reddit / Discord / Bluesky for all the great community feedback and using that to help inform the Bramble Royale roadmap.

And of course, we're also thinking about what's [i]after[/i] that. We're already cooking on some ideas for the 4th Meteorfall game, so stay tuned for more on that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/912a587ee52f5634a71eebea508bb54cde2b5233.png[/img]

[h2]Thank You![/h2]
Whether you're new to the Meteorfall series of games or you've been following us since the release of the original Meteorfall in 2017, we'd like to give a big THANK YOU for all of the support! Game dev is often fun in the beginning and becomes a slog to make it through the last 10% to release. 

One thing that helped was all the reactions and excitement from fans as we posted updates on the game's progress, concept art, etc... Knowing there was a group of folks who were looking forward to more Meteorfall really helped us power through to the end. Feeling grateful for all of you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/c10ba8f006ca294d4fc16eeef1ac6a638b732c11.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo now available!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the debut of the Bramble Royale demo! You can check it out on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3028490/Bramble_Royale_A_Meteorfall_Story_Demo/]Bramble Royale Demo[/url] page.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/1c124fb6e17526b5f0128146292399e421344d94.png[/img]

In the demo, you'll lead a party of Meteorfall OG heroes - Bruno, Mischief, and Greybeard - through the first few fights of a full run. You'll be able to add new cards to your deck, upgrade your cards, and explore the village of Brambletown. There are a few different bosses in the demo, so you may see some old Meteorfall favorites if you play through a few times.

The demo doesn't have everything that the full verison will have, and also doesn't represent the final quality. We anticipate making many improvements based on player feedback. Some key things missing from the demo:
[list]
[*] You won't be able to unlock new heroes or Wild Cards
[*] There isn't any localization. We anticipate having high quality translations for most popular languages by the time we launch
[/list]
The demo will be available for ~2 weeks to give folks plenty of time to check it out. Our goal during the demo is to 1) give players a taste of the game and 2) gather as much feedback as possible. We'd love to hear from you on whatever channel you prefer - Steam forums, [url=discord.gg/meteorfall]Discord[/url] , [url=www.reddit.com/r/meteorfall]Reddit[/url] or [url=x.com/slothwerks]Twitter / X[/url]. Feedback from fans is so critical in this period to help make the game better.

We welcome all types of feedback! Some examples of feedback that would be useful:
[list]
[*] Any mechanics you particularly liked? Disliked?
[*] Any mechanics you found confusing?
[*] Is the game too difficult? Too easy?
[*] Did you encounter any bugs?
[*] Did you run into any technical issues?
[*] If you tried the game on Steam Deck or with a controller, how did it feel?
[/list]
We hope you enjoy this small taste of Bramble Royale and can't wait to hear what you think!

notes.title: Bramble Royale Public Demo Launches on September 25!
notes.content:
Super excited to share that the Bramble Royale demo will launch in just about a week - September 25! It'll be live for a couple weeks to give folks plenty of time to try it.

The demo features:
[list]
[*] Bruno, Mischief and Greybeard (3 of the 8 characters planned for the full version)
[*] The first several battles of a full run
[*] Team customization - take advantage of Team Captain perks
[*] A total of 4 different bosses (varies by run)
[/list]
Lots of love has gone into the development of this game and we can't wait to share a first peek soon!

notes.title: Bramble Royale - Status Update
notes.content:
As the first post for Bramble Royale, I wanted to share an overview of where things are at and what else is on the roadmap before the 1.0 release early next year.

[h3]Where are things at?[/h3]
It's been a LONG journey (more on that in a future post!) but the game is largely defined and playable end-to-end. 6 of the 8 characters are ~90% implemented in terms of cards (animations are completed). 

All of the major systems are present in the game. That includes card upgrades, town vendors, combat sytesm and more. The frameworks required for achievements and localization are completed, but more work will be required there before launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/1c124fb6e17526b5f0128146292399e421344d94.png[/img]

[h3]Current Focus[/h3]
Our current top priority is shipping an initial demo. We're eager to share a taste of Bramble of fans, as well as get some early gameplay and technical feedback on the game. We also know that demos are a really effective tool and generating interest and wishlists and hype.

Additionally, before the demo releases, we want to complete controller / Steam Deck support. Playing on Steam Deck is our favorite way to play and we want to make it's perfect before Bramble's first introduction to the community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/a62cb44e8661be41b1f5525180363fb7654501ed.jpg[/img]

[h3]What else is left?[/h3]
After the demo launch in the next month or so, we'll be focused on the long tail of stuff that you need to do in order to launch a game.

[list]
[*] Intro cinematic
[*] Content (heroes, enemies, cards, perks, etc... )
[*] More voice overs
[*] NG+ levels
[*] Card / item artwork
[*] Localization
[*] Steam Cloud & Achivement integration
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137979/a6ff53e0c83ea6e5023c0d503df1d863da930576.jpg[/img]

As you can see there is still a lot of work to do! This is one of the absolute toughest phases of development, where the game feels almost complete in some ways, but where you need to put in A LOT of work to get that last little bit done. The end result is what separates Very Positive from Overwhelmingly Positive games.

I'm excited to be on this journey and can't wait to share more with you soon!
